units.source_text: 县界上的群山，红锈色彩更加浓重了，

en.t: The mountains along the border had taken on an even deeper rusty red color,

units.source_text: 在夕晖晚照下，有点像冰凉的矿石，发出了暗红的光泽。

en.t: and in the evening light they looked a little like cold ore, giving off a dark red sheen.

units.source_text: 这时间正是客栈赏枫客人最多的时候。

en.t: This was exactly the season when the inn had the most guests coming to view the maples.
